name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.MaskedGGH15.pathProd_maskedSecret
title: Path secrets of the masked shapes: products of diag(P (x) R, M (x) S', S)
statement: The subset product along x of diag(P_{i,b} (x) R_i, M_{i,b} (x) S'_{i,b}, S_{i,b}) is diag(P_x (x) R_*, M_x (x) S'_x, S_x) with the bit-independent R_* = R_0 ... R_{h-1}.
